common_mistakes.mistake: Leave only a hero on PARK and send the other through the purple gate, expecting both to abandon it.
common_mistakes.consequence: PARK is hold-only and the purple gate closes when no accepted weight remains. The missing hero cannot simply walk through the gate; the two bridge roles both lie beyond it.
common_mistakes.recovery: Use the light sac to maintain PARK before moving both heroes on. Any safe local gate blockage permits return/repositioning; a global crate-free impossibility theorem is not claimed.

changed_judgments: Cooperation 3 -> 2: necessary human teamwork is the familiar distinct-role, one-handoff bridge relay; one-person sac setup adds reasoning/execution, not another human mutual dependency. Timing null -> 1: safe-shore effects are repeatable and waiting is available; no timed bridge expiry while correctly held. Recovery null -> 2: a bridge death loses crate and relay setup because retry rebuilds the room. Other scores retain their causal basis.
The bubble introduction is corrected from the later level_01 legend to level_02 actual first-room source/PNG exposure.
unresolved: No novice discovery, enjoyment, success-rate or physical two-person keyboard-comfort study exists.
